scope: Fresh read-only CSV and raw log analysis, followed by nested-field and alternative-key checks; no app or model calls

provenance.execution: One-off Node code executed from standard input; results initially reported in console/chat without creating files
provenance.recording: Aggregate results transcribed during the subsequent documentation update on the same date
provenance.sourceHashes: SHA-256 captured during the documentation update; raw files were read only

method.csvParser: Quoted CSV fields including embedded newlines; each row checked against header width
method.textPair: Exact input_sentence and selected_sentence strings, without normalization
method.textMatch: Only lookup groups containing one distinct exact text pair; this does not prove a unique real selection event
method.deduplication: Exact raw JSON line hashes within each core event before request-key joins; raw row totals retain repeats
method.tripleMeaning: Run, rerun and selection share an original request reference, not proven generation order or regenerated-candidate attribution
method.timeComparison: Event time and API timestamp, then processing timestamp; processing order is not treated as user action order
method.nestedInspection: Recursively inspect llm_infos; inspect trigger enums and explicit child request fields

limits: Counts are rows or observed keys, not verified independent users, requests or actions
Absent rerun events or request IDs in a product do not establish that no retry occurred
CSV lacks full unselected candidate sets and generation-attempt attribution
A common original-request reference does not establish which attempt generated a selected candidate
Core event and API timestamps have hour granularity; finer processing timestamps do not prove action order
Nonempty user_prompt is not established as a retry-reason or satisfaction response
No new explanatory model evaluation, user-effect test, product change or completion of issue 22
